usage: icebath migrate [-h] {xai,relay,openclaw,claude-code,codex,cursor,grok-bot,openbot} ...

With no type: find another agent's setup on this computer (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex CLI,
Cursor, Grok Bot, OpenBot) and offer to import it. Name an agent to import from it; xai and relay
rewrite deprecated settings in the active config.yaml.

positional arguments:
  {xai,relay,openclaw,claude-code,codex,cursor,grok-bot,openbot}
    xai                 Migrate xAI models scheduled for retirement on May 15, 2026
    relay               Convert legacy ICEBATH_NEMO_RELAY_ATIF_*/ATOF_* exporter vars into relay-
                        plugins.toml
    openclaw            Import your OpenClaw setup into Icebath
    claude-code         Import your Claude Code setup into Icebath
    codex               Import your Codex CLI setup into Icebath
    cursor              Import your Cursor setup into Icebath
    grok-bot            Import your Grok Bot setup into Icebath
    openbot             Import your OpenBot setup into Icebath

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
